title: When AI Analysts Disagree: Agentic Multiverse Analysis and the Robustness of Empirical Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.25198v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Every empirical analysis on observational data rests on dozens of defensible analytical choices ("forks") that its readers cannot see. We develop an agentic multiverse analysis (AMA) framework that makes a conclusion's sensitivity to those choices visible at scale, and we position it as a decision-support instrument for human experts. A pilot study first deploys 150 autonomous AI coding agents on one dataset and one set of research questions and finds that they disagree through the same defensible methodological choices human analysts make, though over a narrower range. AI peer review leaves their dispersion almost unchanged. Exposure to top-rated exemplar reports then collapses it, largely through imitation rather than analysis. translated_title: 当AI分析师产生分歧时：智能体多元宇宙分析与实证研究的稳健性
translated_abstract: 每一项基于观测数据的实证分析都依赖于数十种合理但读者无法看见的分析选择（“分叉”）。我们开发了智能体多元宇宙分析（AMA）框架，能够大规模地揭示结论对这些选择的敏感性，并将其定位为面向人类专家的决策支持工具。一项试点研究首先在单个数据集和同一组研究问题上部署了150个自主AI编程智能体，发现它们会通过人类分析师同样会采用的合理方法论选择产生分歧，尽管分歧范围更窄。AI同行评审几乎不会改变其结果的分散程度；而让智能体接触高分示范报告则会大幅收敛这种分歧，且主要通过模仿而非分析实现。基于这些经验教训，AMA让智能体枚举已发表论文所有可能的分析分叉空间，依据有效性评分标准对每个分叉进行评分，执行通过验证的设定网格，并相互交叉审查彼此的工作结果。
tldr: 提出智能体多元宇宙分析（AMA）框架，让AI智能体枚举论文全部合理分析路径并评分、执行、交叉审查，从而大规模揭示实证结论对隐藏分析选择的敏感性，为人类专家提供稳健性决策支持。
en_tdlr: Proposes an Agentic Multiverse Analysis (AMA) framework in which AI agents enumerate, score, execute, and cross-examine the full space of defensible analytical choices ("forks") in published research, revealing at scale how sensitive empirical conclusions are to those hidden choices and serving as decision support for human experts.
